messages:
Oncall-Bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: High 5xx spike inbound on ap-south-1 ELB for inference-hosted-prod /v1/generate. Alerting SRE and pagination oncall. Link: https://grafana.redwood/sys/alert/ELB_5xx_ap-south-1

Alex C: On it. I see latency + target unhealthy counts on the ALB - targeting targets in ap-south-1a. Starting with quick healthcheck.

Chris L: Copy. Pulling target health now — looks like a lot of TAS (target: i-0abc...) show "unavailable" and EBS attach throttles on new instances. EC2 console shows large EBS AttachLatency spike and IO error rates.

Maria S: Customer impact: some hosted API customers in AP region reporting 502/504s and dropped streaming. Opening status page draft — suggest "Partial degradation in AP-South region, routing mitigation in progress". @Jordan T can you coordinate announcements?

Jordan T: I'm with @Maria S. Drafting status now. Holding copy for RBI (legal) review, ETA 10m. Also coordinating handoff to night oncall in 40m — @PagerDuty will handle.

Alex C: Quick mitigation plan: 1) Remove unhealthy targets from ALB target group 2) Shift weighted Route53 traffic for inference-hosted-prod to eu-west-1 temporarily 3) Scale up warm pools in eu-west-1 and us-west-2 4) Engage AWS support for EBS attach I/O.

Chris L: Running: ```bash
# remove unhealthy targets
aws elbv2 deregister-targets --target-group-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:ap-south-1:123456:targetgroup/tg-infer/abcd --targets Id=i-0abc1234
# update target-group to drain
aws elbv2 modify-target-group-attributes --target-group-arn ... --attributes Key=deregistration_delay.timeout_seconds,Value=30
```

Alex C: Done removing the obvious bad nodes — ALB TargetHealthyHostCount from 4 -> 10 after draining and replacing.

Cloud Support: AWS acknowledged a regional issue affecting EBS provisioning in ap-south-1. Case # 987654321. They report "elevated control-plane attach latency" impacting new instance boots and volume attaches. No ETA yet.

Maria S: Okay routing shift imminent. @Chris L can you prepare Route53 change? We'll do a weighted shift 80% eu-west-1, 20% ap-south-1 to reduce load while keeping minority traffic for validation.

Chris L: Command to set weighted record:
```bash
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id ZZZZZ --change-batch '{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"inference.api.redwood.ai.","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"eu-west-1","Weight":80,"AliasTarget":{"HostedZoneId":"H1","DNSName":"dualstack-alb-eu-west-1.amazonaws.com","EvaluateTargetHealth":false}} , {"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"inference.api.redwood.ai.","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"ap-south-1","Weight":20,"AliasTarget":{"HostedZoneId":"H2","DNSName":"dualstack-alb-ap-south-1.amazonaws.com","EvaluateTargetHealth":false}}]}}'
```

Jordan T: Applying now. Note: TTLs are 60s — quick. Apply and monitor.

Oncall-Bot: :white_check_mark: ROUTE53 change submitted by Chris L — change id C0123456 — propagation in progress.

Maria S: Status page published: "Investigating: service degraded in AP-South region, traffic being shifted to alternate region." Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-03-ap-south

Alex C: Monitoring telemetry — 5xx rate in ap-south-1 dropped ~65% within 3 minutes of weight change. Latency normalized for eu-west-1 traffic. Some long-running streams in ap-south-1 still failing; working on draining connections gracefully.

Cloud Support: AWS engineer just posted: "Investigating control plane EBS attach latencies. For warm pools that create instances with new EBS volumes, attach may timeout leading to instance failures. Recommended: use existing healthy instances or detach/reattach volumes from healthy AZs." Link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/ cases/987654321

Chris L: As temporary fix we're changing autoscaling launch template to avoid creating new volumes in AP until AWS confirms. Patch:
```json
{"BlockDeviceMappings":[{"DeviceName":"/dev/xvda","Ebs":{"VolumeType":"gp3","DeleteOnTermination":true}}],"MetadataOptions":{"HttpTokens":"required"}}
```

Alex C: Also enabled ALB cross-zone load balancing to better utilize healthy targets across AZs in ap-south-1.

Jordan T: Handoff reminder: @PagerDuty you'll take the next 4h. Please watch for post-change regressions and coordinate with customer success for inbound tickets.

PagerDuty: Ack — taking oncall. Paging schedule updated. If anything escalates use oncall#escalation.

Maria S: Customer comms: CS drafted an email to top 20 customers in AP region. Template includes: apology, what we're doing, temporary mitigations, expected next updates in 2 hours. Approving now.

Chris L: Small note — observed DNS TTL respects but some edge caches took up to ~2 minutes to shift due to ISP caching. We'll note that in comms.

Oncall-Bot: :memo: ACTIONS LOGGED: route53-weight-shift, remove-unhealthy-targets, disable-autoscaling-volume-creation-ap, contact-aws-support-case-987654321

Alex C: I'm going to keep this thread open and will post a short postmortem stub once AWS updates. If anyone sees 5xx resurgence after 30m, ping here w/ request-id and example curl.

Cloud Support: AWS updated: "We've mitigated the attach-plane issue; you should see attach latencies return to baseline. Please validate by attempting a create/attach in a non-prod subnet." ETA close message in 18m.

Maria S: OK confirm non-prod attach succeeded. We'll gradually restore weights to original over next 90 minutes and monitor.

Chris L: Restoring weights ->1500 -> now at 95% AP, 5% eu for verification, no 5xx spike. Rolling back warm-pool changes in autopatch.

Jordan T: Final note for runbook: add a step to prefer reuse of existing EBS volumes during attach storms, and add a guard to ASG launch template to fallback to ephemeral storage if attach fails for >3 attempts.

Alex C: Thanks team. I'll sleep on a postmortem draft tomorrow. Closing incident when AWS posts final case resolution. :zzz:

PagerDuty: Incident acknowledged as mitigated. Closing watch in 2h unless regression.

Chris L: Leaving logs and perf graphs in runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/incident/ap-south-ebs-attach-2026

Oncall-Bot: :white_check_mark: Thread archived for incident 1799010000
